## [1.5.3-dev.1](https://github.com/ch3thanhs/stylus/compare/v1.5.2...v1.5.3-dev.1) (2026-09-24)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **bitwarden and github:** update app support ([a8a8b58](https://github.com/ch3thanhs/stylus/commit/a8a8b588a3998cbb55223f50c253e2d5444308da))

patches.name: Custom font (GitHub)
patches.description: Replaces GitHub's bundled Inter and Mona Sans UI fonts with a custom font file.

options.description: The file path to your font file. Tap the file picker and select it. The font file must be in TTF or OTF format. A variable font is recommended so heading and body text keep their different weights.

patches.name: Custom monospace font (GitHub)
patches.description: Replaces GitHub's bundled Roboto Mono code font with a custom monospace font file.

options.description: The file path to your monospace font file. Tap the file picker and select it. The font file must be in TTF or OTF format.

patches.name: Force system font (GitHub)
patches.description: Renders GitHub UI text using the device system font by overriding bundled font resources at runtime.

patches.name: Force system font (including monospace) (GitHub)
patches.description: Renders GitHub UI and monospace text using the device system UI font.

patches.name: Force system font (Instagram)
patches.description: Renders Instagram UI text using the device system font.

patches.name: Force system font (Bitwarden)
patches.description: Renders the app using the device's system font instead of DM Sans / Roboto.
